item.title: Comply.LM — Full 46-Day AEO/GEO Schedule & Content Library (30-Keyword Panel)
item.description: A plain-English operating plan for a 46-day AEO/GEO sprint for Comply.LM (a LawMatter product), built around a fixed panel of 30 long-tail AML/CTF keywords across six segments — lawyers, conveyancers, accountants, real estate, jewellers and general RegTech. Day-by-day schedule from 30 September to 14 November 2026, a library where every deliverable links to its own brief, the keyword-to-asset map, and the Claims Ledger that decides which claims are allowed to publish.

item.title: Comply.LM-test — Full 46-Day AEO/GEO Schedule & Content Library (30-Keyword Panel)
item.description: A plain-English operating plan for a 46-day AEO/GEO sprint for Comply.LM-test, built around a fixed panel of 30 long-tail AML/CTF keywords across six segments — lawyers, conveyancers, accountants, real estate, jewellers and general RegTech. The schedule runs from 30 September to 14 November 2026 and publishes two blogs in each full seven-day sprint week, with the summit preview and logistics combined as one post.
